_meta.description: Spend profile and its spread per treatment arm on experiment.pulse: a named vector lists revenue_before, revenue and session_minutes with display labels; AGG_VEC_MEAN returns each arm's mean per member and AGG_VEC_SD the per-member SAMPLE standard deviation (n - 1; weighted: sum(w) - 1 under kind frequency, Kish n_eff - 1 under probability). params.expand writes the spread as one f64 column per member, "spend_sd[before]" and so on, which a Sort key or a later chain stage can read. Missing data is per element: element_n can differ by member. An element answered by one row or none is null, never 0.
_meta.name: vector_sd_per_arm
